system.description: Ejecting a fist-sized crystal dodecahedron from his mouth that unfolds into an floating widget made of whirling blades, short spikes and a featureless mirrored face the size of a human head, the weaver gazes at the mirror face and speaks a message into it. This protocol then functions exactly like Infallible Messenger (see Exalted, p. 254), except the recipient can see the speaker's image in the crystal as well as hear him and may even view events taking place in the background. GOD-MACHINE PROTOCOLS These powerful protocols have the potential to reformat the shape of Autochthonia, being a far more advanced form of pattern manipulation than the Man-Machine protocols. As such, these protocols belong to Autochthon alone and are shared with only his most favored children. Also, being closer in nature to sorcery than necromancy, God-Machine Protocols may be countered with Sapphire or Obsidian Countermagic, or better. These protocols fall in might somewhere between Celestial and Solar Circle sorcery or Labyrinth and Void Circle necromancy.
